Official repository/docs: pure-Rust parametric CAD; desktop, browser, CLI and MCP access; README describes the project as early but usable for simple parts.

The official README demo shows a Raspberry Pi case built with sketches, dimensions, extrusion, rounding, shelling, patterning and side-port cuts. Describe the demo as the project's own footage, not an independent test.
Do not call SolidCraft a Fusion 360 replacement, production-grade, or fully CAD-compatible. Reference-part checks do not establish full compatibility.

scenes.headline: SOLIDCRAFT *CAD*
scenes.say: SolidCraft CAD lets AI agents edit parametric models through MCP.
The Raspberry Pi case gets a pattern; the official demo cuts side ports.
As of October thirteenth, SolidCraft had {1,339|one thousand three hundred thirty nine} stars and an {Apache-2.0|Apache two point zero} license.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT *SUPPORTS*
scenes.say: It supports sketches, editable features, a desktop app, browser, CLI and MCP for agents.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
scenes.say: The catch? It's early and meant for simple parts; full CAD compatibility isn't proven. It's open source under Apache two point zero, with MCP for agents.
Would you trust AI with your next part? Comment CAD for the repo.

youtube.description:
SolidCraft is a Rust parametric CAD app for desktop and browser, with a headless CLI and MCP server for agent control. Its official demo builds a Raspberry Pi case with editable features. The project calls itself early but usable for simple parts; reference checks do not establish full CAD compatibility. Apache-2.0. Captured Oct 13, 2026: 1,339 stars.
GitHub: https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft
